title: 2002 AMC 8 Problem 25
statement: Loki, Moe, Nick and Ott are good friends. Ott had no money, but the others did. Moe gave Ott one-fifth of his money, Loki gave Ott one-fourth of his money and Nick gave Ott one-third of his money. Each gave Ott the same amount of money. What fractional part of the group’s money does Ott now have?

solutions.text:
Because only the fractions matter, suppose each person gave Ott \(\$1.\) This means that Moe had \(\$5,\) Loki had \(\$4,\) and Nick had \(\$3\) originally.

The transfers do not change the group’s total amount of money, which is \[ \$5 + \$4 + \$3 = \$12. \] Ott now has \(\$3.\)

This means that Ott has \[ \dfrac{3}{12} = \dfrac{1}{4} \] of the group’s money.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Assume each friend gives Ott the same convenient amount.
If each gives Ott \(\$1,\) work backward to each friend’s original amount.
